supersedes.what_changed: radio_friction was fabricated as a conflict and set to the ground BOX friction 0.45; corrected to the radio's own 0.80. Static friction set to the desktop 0.75. Nine further r1 'divergences' reclassified as single-world actor definitions

purpose: ONE physical definition shared by every local and full trial (plan 5.2)

static_roi.note: native static ROI; no added floor, no welded caps, no global Z plane. Meshes use GEOM_FORCE_CONCAVE_TRIMESH split every 3000 triangles -- a transport split that does not change triangles or transforms

static_friction.why: the native statics are the SAME bodies in both runs, so this is a genuine conflict. 0.75 is chosen because the table is a native static and R's slide-vs-carry behaviour on it governs the desktop mechanism that must survive the merge; 0.65 was tuned for boxes knocked along the floor. The alternative is retained and P3 perturbs this by +-10%

contactBreakingThreshold.why: a global engine setting; the more conservative of the two is kept. Plan 5.2: this is NOT an allowed-penetration amount, so nothing here forgives penetration

radio_friction.why: the ground world has NO radio; this is the radio's own measured probe value

receiving_box_friction.why: R is a desktop actor sitting on the table; the probe's own value is kept so the validated desktop mechanism is not perturbed by a merge

ball_friction.why: ball is a desktop actor; probe value kept

A.mass_source: DECLARED ASSUMPTION, not measured: '1.5/2.5kg estimates, mass concentrated in main body'. The 2.5 kg variant FAILED and is not hidden

A.com_body_frame_m: at the base body origin, because every link mass is zero

frame.world: shared world
frame.base_pose_convention: base origin = box centre = COM

R.mass_source: same declared estimate as the paper ground boxes

coordinate_system_statement: PyBullet basePosition/baseOrientation place the multibody BASE ORIGIN. For the boxes that equals the box centre and therefore the COM. For the radio the base origin is the base body's origin and, because every link mass is zero, that is also the COM. For the tape the base origin is wedge 0's origin, which is NOT the ring centre, so the ring's COM is offset from the base origin; the ring inertia is expressed about the ring axis as the validated runs did. Blender consumes the same transform chain, so a COM offset must never be passed as if it were a mesh position
open_issues: the ball's initial state is a LOCAL PROBE state; plan 6.1 requires extending it along the un-collided ballistic arc for a 0.15-0.30 s visible flight and re-solving the whole path from the new state
the radio and tape masses are declared estimates, not measurements; a COM/inertia revision invalidates the old desktop feasibility and requires re-validation
the relay diagnostic used a diagnostic-only input ('first block initial edge rotation 5 rad/s') with full_chain_acceptance false; it is NOT a production input
R's friction 0.40 and the ground paper boxes' 0.45 are the same asset class at different interfaces; recorded as single-world per actor, and P3's sensitivity gate perturbs the static friction only

relay_probe_diagnostic_input.value: first block initial edge rotation 5 rad/s
relay_probe_diagnostic_input.why_forbidden: a diagnostic-only initial condition supplied to the FIRST BLOCK of a window. Using it as production input would replace real upstream energy transfer with a hand-supplied rotation rate
